test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: According to the archaeologists, in Harappan cities the part to the west was smaller and higher, was known as ______.
solution:
The correct answer is C__**itadel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Numerous of these cities had two or more **distinct portions**.
 
• The area to the west was often **taller **and **smaller**.
 
• This is referred to by **archaeologists **as the **citadel**.
 
• In general, the **eastern portion **was **lower **and **larger**.
 
• The **lower town** is what it's known as.
 
• Each component was frequently surrounded by the **walls **made of **baked brick**.
 
• The bricks have **endured **for countless years because of how well they were built.
 
• The walls were **robust **because the bricks were arranged in an **interlocking manner**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• Special buildings were built on the **citadel **in **certain cities**.
 
• For instance, in **Mohenjodaro**, a highly unusual tank known as the **Great Bath **was constructed in this region.
 
• This was plastered, lined with bricks, and sealed with a layer of natural tar to **prevent leaks**.
 
• From two sides, steps led down to it, and **chambers **surrounded it on all sides.
 
• Most likely, water was brought in from a **well **and emptied after usage.
